item.title: How to Secure Ipfs Node
item.description:
Why You Should Never Expose the IPFS RPC API Publicly (and How to Secure It)

When running an IPFS node, one of the most important security considerations is how you handle ports and the RPC API. Many new users unknowingly expose their node’s RPC API to the internet, leaving it wide open for abuse. In this post, we’ll explore why this is dangerous and how you can protect yourself with IPFS’s built-in basic authentication.
